Thank you for adopting this open textbook! Your registration is public evidence of real classroom use — it helps improve the chapters and builds the case for the print edition.

感谢采用本开源教材！您的登记是真实课堂使用的公开佐证，既能帮助改进各章内容，也为出版版积累依据。

**Term 学期**
<!-- e.g., 2026–2027–1 -->

**Chapters used 使用章节**
